verdict: Meta leads surged this week; Google Ads and key launch milestones remain overdue.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 7 leads from Meta at a cost of $74.37 per lead — and the most recent three days (Sep 6–8) show that cost dropping to roughly $52 per lead, a sign the campaign is finding its footing. All $520.61 in spend this period ran through Meta; Google Ads has not launched and has recorded $0 in spend across the full reporting window, which is blocking a meaningful portion of your planned budget from working. Five launch milestones — including Google Search, LSA verification, and Meta retargeting — have been overdue since late July and early August, and closing those gaps is the immediate priority. Google Business Profile activity also went quiet over the past eight days after a strong stretch in August; we're watching that closely to keep organic touchpoints active. Expect Google Ads to come online in the near term, which should materially expand your lead volume and give us a second channel to optimize against.
